phase_0.boundary_condition: The XML schema root element seals and contains every tag and steering constraint as a nested hierarchy.

⊢.justification: No tag or constraint exists yet, so the register holds the void state before anything is named.

⊣.justification: It closes and contains the whole system, with influence flowing through containment and branching rather than arbitrary links.

≻.chosen_element: prompt input moving into schema constraints
≻.justification: It directs transformation from user text toward constrained model completion.

≺.chosen_element: model response checked against schema rules
≺.justification: It sends validation backward from generated output to the input interface.

⋈.justification: It composes structural elements sequentially so constraints propagate from root to leaf.

⊙.chosen_element: schema root carrying the full constraint bulk
⊙.justification: Surface and interior form one register of self-recognition where the element contains itself.

∈.justification: It opens one input state into two arms: valid steering input and malformed input rejection.

∋.justification: It reconstitutes the accepted arm and the rejection log into a single active constraint register.

⊤.justification: It is the affirmative state where the input matches schema rules and steers behavior.

⊥.justification: It is the negative state where the input fails validation and is excluded from steering.

⊞.chosen_element: contradictory steering constraints at the critical threshold
⊞.justification: It holds both scale-free sensitivity and maximal correlation simultaneously without resolution.

⊡.justification: It is a permanent append-only record that cannot be undone once fixed.

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized schema buffer before any tag is parsed and no constraint exists.

phase_3.false_description: Malformed input rejected by the schema and excluded from steering.
phase_3.both_description: Contradictory steering constraints held live at the critical threshold without resolution.
